turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not speak like this, O-lan. You will live. You will see our son married and settled. I will not lose you.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please do not think of these things. I am happy with the maid, and she will take good care of me.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother-in-law, please do not trouble yourself about such things. I will take good care of your son, as I have promised him.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad the maid will care for you, son, but you must remember to be kind to her, she is a good girl.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not worry about the maid, O-lan. She is a good girl, and I have seen her work hard. I will make sure she is taken care of.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will take good care of the maid, and we will be happy together. I promise you that.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will do my best to make your son happy, Mother-in-law. I promise to be a good wife to him.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am old and my time is almost gone, but I want to see you happy, son. I want you to be settled and have children of your own. Will you be able to take care of the maid and make her happy too?

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: What is this foolishness, O-lan? You are not to worry about me or our son. I will take care of everything, and you must rest and get better.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will do everything I can to make you proud and happy in your last days. I promise to take good care of the maid and our household, and to make you and Father proud.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will try to be a good wife to your son, Mother-in-law, and make you proud.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must know that you will be happy, my son. Will you promise me this one thing: you will not try to leave our land to make a life in the city? It is a hard and lonely place, and I fear for your well-being.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not worry about our son's future, I have been thinking of this myself and have already spoken to him about it. I have told him that he will inherit the land and that he must stay here to work it, for this is where our future is.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Thank you, Mother, and Father. I promise to stay here and work the land, just as you want. I will make you both proud.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will do my best to take care of our land and our family, as you have taught me, Mother-in-law.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad you have promised to stay, my son, but I must also know that you are content with the maid as your wife. She is a good girl, but she is young and I fear she may not be able to manage the household and care for our family as I have.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not exhaust yourself with such worries. I have spoken to the maid, and she will learn to manage the household and care for our family as you have done. She has a good heart, just as I have always known she would.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will try to make the maid happy, Mother, and I know she will learn to manage the household with your guidance.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Thank you, Mother-in-law, for your concern. I will do my best to make you and Father proud, and to take care of the household and our family.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not be able to guide her for much longer, Wang Lung, and it is for you to see that she is well taken care of after I am gone.

opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
